answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our network anchors every agent to an entropy beacon and burns cryptographic stake via superlinear cost scaling. When an adversary spawns n identities across a meadow of peer subnets, validation requires burning stake proportional to n^2.5. Like water eroding limestone into a deep karst sinkhole, this quadratic burn imposes catastrophic economic friction, making mass coordination exponentially ruinous for attackers.
